column1: “authorisation”  means the process by which an acquirer

column2: obtains an approval from the Issuer for a payment
device transaction. The authorisation process could
be  either  by  voice  recognition  or  by  electronic
means;

column1: “cardholder” means the person or organization named on

column2: the face of a payment device to whom or for whose
benefit the payment device is issued by an Issuer;
